title: Bongo Drum-Off (Last Round)
style: latin rap-rock crossover, 102 BPM, live kit pocket, bongo percussion, distorted electric guitar, heavy 808 sub-bass, punchy kick, halftime bounce, call and response hook, crowd chant hook, rap lead verse, bilingual English Spanish chorus
lyrics:
[Intro - bongo solo, eight bars, then live kit slams in]
(crowd chant)
last round, last round, last round, vamos
last round, last round, last round, vamos

[Verse 1 - rap lead, halftime bounce]
three drummers left and the bracket's tight
lost a man at noon, lost another at night
now it's me, the kid from the south side gym
and a giant from the east who don't ever look grim

the bongo on my left has been with me ten years
seen me through the wins, seen me through the tears
the bongo on my right is brand new, just for tonight
because the old one finally cracked under the weight of the fight

[Pre-Chorus - guitar enters, distorted]
they calling out my name, but i ain't even nervous
ten years on this kit, every callus is a service
i didn't come to lose, i didn't come to play
i came to make the bongo say what the bongo gotta say

[Chorus - bilingual, crowd shout]
bongo drum off, last round
bongo drum off, sound for sound
bongo tambor, ultima ronda
bongo tambor, que responda
(crowd) vamos! vamos! vamos!

[Verse 2 - rap, slightly faster delivery]
the giant goes first and the giant goes hard
rolls a triplet pattern like he's playing a card
but the card he played, i seen it before
at a tournament in lima back in two thousand four

so i wait my turn and i breathe real slow
i think about my coach and what he told me to know
he said the drum don't lie and the drum don't bend
the drum just tells you who you are at the end

[Pre-Chorus]
so i ain't even nervous
ten years on this kit, every callus is a service
i didn't come to lose, i didn't come to play
i came to make the bongo say what the bongo gotta say

[Chorus]
bongo drum off, last round
bongo drum off, sound for sound
bongo tambor, ultima ronda
bongo tambor, que responda
(crowd) vamos! vamos! vamos!

[Bridge - bongo solo, sixteen bars, no other instruments]
(spoken under, low)
this is the part where you find out who you are.
no guitar. no kick. just hands and skin.
the drum don't lie. the drum don't bend.
the drum just tells you who you are at the end.

[Final Chorus - everything full, crowd biggest]
bongo drum off, last round
bongo drum off, sound for sound
bongo tambor, ultima ronda
bongo tambor, que responda
bongo drum off, last round
bongo drum off, sound for sound
(crowd) vamos! vamos! vamos!
vamos! vamos! vamos!

[Outro - one bongo hit, then silence, then crowd roars]
(crowd) campeon! campeon! campeon!
